rule: Minnesota's state and local races on the November 3, 2026 ballot, keyed by the race ids in ballot_local_2026.sqlite, by the same rule as the Congress pages (ballot/polls/polls_2026.json). Polls only from pollsters in AAPOR's Transparency Initiative (John, 2026-09-29): the latest from up to five of them, and our own average of the ten most recent, the arithmetic shown. Each poll's figures are checked against the pollster's own release; a list of polls (Wikipedia's, labelled as secondary) is used only to find them and to count the polls left out.

polls.note: Asked in February as a matchup between likely nominees, six months before the August 11 primary. The question named the two candidates for governor, not their running mates. Of the rest, 4.6% chose someone else and 6.6% were undecided.

pollsters: SurveyUSA (seven, for KSTP: three of November's matchup, three of the Republican primary only, and one of Tim Walz against four Republicans, September 15-18, 2025)
Big Data Poll (two, the Republican primary, for Mike Lindell's campaign)
TIPP Insights (for the League of American Workers)
Mason-Dixon Polling & Strategy (for the Minnesota Star Tribune, KARE 11 and the University of Minnesota's Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication)
Minnesota Private Business Council (the Republican primary; the group's own internal poll)
Peak Insights (the Republican primary, for Michele Tafoya's campaign for U.S. Senate)
RMG Research (Tim Walz against an unnamed Republican, December 10-16, 2025, for Alpha News)
left_out.note: Emerson's February survey is the only poll of this race by a pollster in the Transparency Initiative. Emerson's own site lists no later Minnesota release, and ActiVote's 2026 page says it has published no statewide poll yet (both read 2026-10-01). RealClearPolling's list answered our check with 403 and was not read.
